messages:
lee_ops: Starting a config-only rollout in the 13:00 change window. Scope: routing fanout adjustments, per-tenant soft-rate caps, micro-batching shrink (max_batch_tokens 800 -> 700), and idle_request_timeout bump to 300ms. Canary plan: 3% EU + APAC for 10m, then geo-aware ramp. No model changes. Release notes drafted: https://redwood.internal/notes/1765554321

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by lee_ops. Job ID: db-20260323-17655b. Start ETA: 2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00. Type: config-only. Canary: 3% (regions=eu,apac).

nina: Confirming per-tenant cap defaults? I think we set soft-cap to 120 rps per-tenant for canary, falling back to runtime throttle if exceeded.

chris: Correct. Config will include runtimeThrottle: { mode: "soft", rps_per_tenant: 120, enforcement_window_s: 30 }. This should prevent hot-tenant-induced 429 spikes during routing concentration.

lee_ops: Rollback thresholds: sustained p50 > baseline + 100ms OR p95 > baseline + 250ms OR global 5xx > 0.4% for 3m OR tenant-level 429 > 1% for 2m. Escalate to #eng-oncall and PD if any hard threshold hit. Add watch for batching queue depth increase > 40%.

deploy-bot: Canary phase started for job db-20260323-17655b at 2026-03-23T13:00:05-07:00. Canary fraction: 3% (eu,apac).

nina: Observing first 4m: p50 +7ms, p95 +12ms, no error uptick. Per-tenant caps not tripping yet.

lee_ops: Config payload (in case you need it):
```
{
  "routing": {"fanout": 3, "weights": {"stable": 0.97, "canary": 0.03}},
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 700, "micro_batch_delay_ms": 8},
  "runtimeThrottle": {"mode": "soft", "rps_per_tenant": 120, "window_s": 30},
  "timeouts_ms": {"idle_request": 300}
}
```
Note: fanout=3 enables slightly broader routing to spread load.

chris: micro_batch_delay 8ms ok. Keep an eye on tokens/sec; smaller batches can affect GPU utilization but helps tail latency.

oncall_bot: Alert rule added: eng/inference-config-canary -> notify #eng-oncall and pagerduty on hard thresholds. Soft alert at p50 +50ms to #eng-releases.

nina: 9m in: small spike of tenant-local 429s in APAC region (tenant: acme-eu). Looks like routing favoring that tenant.

lee_ops: Immediate mitigation: reduce canary fraction in APAC to 0.5% and keep EU at 3%. Commanding scale: 
```
redwoodctl rollout scale --job db-20260323-17655b --region apac --fraction 0.005
```

deploy-bot: Scaling canary: job db-20260323-17655b -> region=apac fraction -> 0.5% as requested.

chris: Also enabling per-tenant runtime throttle enforcement (soft -> enforced) for acme-eu as a temporary measure while we analyze. Command: 
```
redwoodctl tenant throttle set --tenant acme-eu --rps 60 --enforce true
```

nina: Enforcement applied. Monitoring for drop in 429s.

lee_ops: 18m mark: APAC 429s dropped to baseline after enforced throttle. p50/p95 stable. Recommend hold at current fractions for 12m, then slow ramp to global 3% if stable.

chris: Agree. Also flagging to product that per-tenant soft caps may need product review; they hit enforcement in rollout.

lee_ops: If everything remains stable, plan to merge config to release/stable tomorrow and add a post-release note about enabling per-tenant soft caps by default.

deploy-bot: Job db-20260323-17655b -> ROLLING_FULL (ramp complete) at 2026-03-23T13:40:00-07:00. No auto-rollback triggered.

nina: Final metrics: p50 +5ms, p95 +18ms, global 5xx 0.06%, per-tenant throttle traces show expected hits but no widespread failures.

lee_ops: Closing job db-20260323-17655b. Release note: https://redwood.internal/notes/1765554321/complete. Thanks team.

chris: Nice coordination. Follow-up action: add a dashboard tile for tenant-throttle-hits and include it in future canaries.

lee_ops: Will do. Thread remains open for followups.
